definition: A value $a$ with $f(a) = 0$: a root of $f(x) = 0$, and the $x$-coordinate of a point where the graph meets the $x$-axis.
The turning point of a parabola: its minimum point if it opens upwards, its maximum point if it opens downwards.
A line that a graph can be folded along so that its two halves match; for a parabola, the vertical line through its vertex.
